verdict.rationale: Salesforce ships an official npm-installable `sf` CLI with scriptable commands suited to CI pipelines: `sf org create scratch` for ephemeral orgs, `sf apex run test`, `sf data query`, and `sf agent create`/`activate`. DevOps Center is positioned for building, testing and deploying at scale, and a community user independently confirms a passable CLI and an easy deployment path. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of headless/non-interactive authentication (e.g., JWT or service-account login) and of CI pipeline integration, plus hands-on corroboration of running in CI.
